name: sonnet-1
how: A fresh Claude Code subagent that could read only the rendered prompts (one file per case), answered them in order and wrote each reply, unedited, to a file. No API key; nothing else in its context.

{"verdict": "missing", "test": "cancel returns to the cart @regression", "reason": "The test clicks Cancel but its only assertion runs before the click and the cart URL check is commented out, so nothing verifies the destination."}
